Empower Your Business with a World-Class Marketplace Platform
 
 
 
 
 
Marketplacer is a marketplace platform and dropshipping solution that allows mid and enterprise companies to scale and grow in today’s evolving e-commerce environment. Our integration solutions make it easy for you to incorporate third-party seller inventory into your e-commerce platform, unlocking a world of growth opportunities.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Let's Connect
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Discover the extensive capabilities of Marketplacer
 
 
 
 
 Our platform 
seamlessly connects
 your e-commerce front end with third-party sellers’ inventory, ensuring minimal disruption to your existing systems.
With Marketplacer, you can expand your offerings with third-party products, enhancing your business without compromising the efficiency of your established operations. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Harness the power of Marketplacer's Seller Community
 
 
 
 
 
Our expansive seller community gives merchants access to thousands of premium global sellers. Merchants can view seller catalogs and filter for rapid range extension through easy discovery and onboarding of quality sellers and products.
For sellers, we facilitate remarkable growth by providing them with the seamless opportunity to reach our extensive network of leading operators, who collectively draws in 2 billion annual visitors and generates an impressive $35 billion in annual e-commerce sales.

A world-class marketplace platform to successfully launch your very own marketplace
 
 
 
 
 
Marketplacer emerges as a leading marketplace platform, fully loaded with an array of tools and functionalities tailored to foster the development of successful and scalable online marketplaces.
Our advanced marketplace platform empowers you to broaden your product offerings, eliminating the complexities of inventory management. By leveraging the capabilities of the Marketplacer Marketplace Platform, you can unlock new opportunities and drive your business towards new heights of success. Embrace the marketplace advantage and explore the limitless potential that comes with it.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Book a Demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Who is using Marketplacer
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
eCommerce growth without the need for new warehousing or stock holdings
 
 
 
 
 
Our Marketplace Platform is a dynamic solution that integrates your eCommerce interface with third-party products and sellers on Marketplacer, enabling you to enhance your product range easily and offer a wider, more diverse selection to your customers.
As your customers place orders, our Marketplace Platform ensures an easy and efficient integration back into Marketplacer. This efficient process is key to guaranteeing prompt and effective order fulfillment by third-party sellers, thereby ensuring a smooth and satisfying shopping experience for your customers.
Our Marketplace Platform is comprehensive, covering all vital aspects of e-commerce marketplace operations. This includes the management of shipments, efficient handling of refunds, meticulous oversight of seller remittances, and much more, making it an all-encompassing solution for your online marketplace needs.

The Marketplacer platform technology is designed to augment and enhance your commerce architecture while putting valuable tools into the hands of operators, sellers and shoppers.
The Marketplacer platform technology supports operators to seamlessly manage their digital commerce strategy while delivering the experience sellers want and shoppers expect.

Frequently Asked Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is a marketplace platform? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
At a very basic level, a marketplace platform allows a seller and buyer to connect under a marketplace brand or business. Online, it’s a virtual space where sellers can display their product and/or service and where buyers can directly connect with sellers, finding what they need when they need it. A marketplace platform is the conduit for the business transaction, from start to finish, enabling a seamless user experience for both the seller and the buyer, ensuring minimal friction and maximum opportunities for success.
Marketplaces aren’t a new concept. For as long as we’ve had things to sell and the desire to buy, marketplaces have existed. The traditional platform was a tangible place locked into a specific geographic location, and sometimes a specific time, that buyers knew to frequent for their needs. This allowed multiple merchants to display their wares across various industries, creating a one-stop-destination experience for buyers.
With the advent of the world wide web, we’ve seen the rise of the digital marketplace, breaking this time old tradition of physical marketplaces. We can now buy and sell with the click of a button through our devices. There has never been a better time to grow your business online.
Not all marketplace platforms are created equal, and not all offer the same benefits and opportunities.
What Marketplacer offers is: 
Our 10+ years of experience and expertise in marketplace technology and software. 
Our proven methodology for success has allowed our customers to execute on successful and proven marketplace strategies that have levelled up their growth, reach and revenue. 
Our marketplace platform comes equipped with all the tools you need to onboard your sellers and their products at a pace so your marketplace will always be ready to meet your business needs as you grow and evolve. 
 Our marketplace platform is designed to offer you the ability to foster and engage your own community of sellers and buyers through your business or brand. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How to build a marketplace platform? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
With Marketplacer, you get ease, relevance and convenience at all stages of your experience building your marketplace platform. We call this our Platform for Success, encompassing Discovery, Technology and Success.
 
Discover
First, we guide you through discovery to understand your business; your customer needs and define what success looks like for you within the digital marketplace.
 
Technology
Our modular-built design and extensively customisable features and integrations provide you with full control of curating your marketplace platform exactly how you desire it. This allows you to spend your time and efforts where your business needs it the most while the marketplace continues to take care of itself as it grows and evolves.
 
Success
We support you through implementation and managing your services, optimising your marketplace for success.
We’ve partnered with a range of partner systems so you won’t have to worry about add ons, compatible features and applications – we’ve done the hard work for you. Your job is to curate your marketplace platform in a way that best suits your and the sellers and buyers’ needs.
 
Headless and Connected Solutions
If you already have a digital marketplace, we’ve got you covered with our Headless and Connected Solutions, where we can integrate your existing ecommerce platform with a Marketplacer marketplace platform.
The future of marketplaces is digital and global. We can connect you to your sellers and your customers around the globe with our world-class marketplace platform with minimal fuss and maximum effectiveness.
Connect with us to see how Marketplacer can help you successfully level up your marketplace.

Security Overview
 
 
 
 
 
We take data security seriously. Our dedicated security team follows industry best practices and has adopted controls such as SAML SSO, Encryption, Multi-Factor Authentication, Cloud Security to keep our customers’ data secure.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Our approach to security operations and best practices
 
 
 
 
 
Security practices are applied at every phase of the software development life cycle:
Security requirements are gathered at the early stage.
Design phase identifies security risks via Threat Modelling, Attack Surface Analysis. Controls for input validation included.
The development phase relies on frameworks that require the use of secure coding practices.
Code is tested by someone who did not develop the source code. Automated security tests are also performed for working as expected verification.
All security vulnerabilities are identified and patched within strict time frames which our security department monitor constantly
Operational practices
We maintain a list of our information assets and have adopted industry recommended operational security practices which align to our security certification programs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Applicable international standards
 
 
 
 
 
We apply to our product development and our operations environment a set of international standards.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
ISO 27001:2022
 
 
 
 
 
We are 
ISO 27001 certified
, this standard sets out the specification for an effective information security management system (ISMS).
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SOC2 Type II
 
 
 
 
 
We are SOC2 Type I certified, this cybersecurity standard defines the criteria for managing customer data.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PCI-DSS
 
 
 
 
 
Our platform is PCI-DSS SAQ A compliant. Ensuring that our platform integrates with trusted payment providers safely and securely.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Platform and network security
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Security Testing 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Penetration tests are part of our continual improvement strategy that helps us to tighten up the security measures.
Penetration tests are conducted periodically to uncover security vulnerabilities our applications. Security vulnerabilities are patched in a timely manner.
We also welcome external security researchers that have discovered a security defect or vulnerability in one of our products or platforms.
We have developed a policy on how to responsibly disclose security defects or vulnerabilities affecting Marketplacer products and services which can be found in our responsible disclosure policy.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Security Incident & Response Management 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We have adopted safeguards to reduce the vulnerability of our information systems and to help protect our customers’ data. However, we understand that security incidents can still happen.
We have developed a Security Incident Response Procedure to handle security incidents to minimise an incident duration and negative impact.
The procedure enables our Security Incident and Response team to implement appropriate action to contain, eradicate and recover from an incident. It also outlines the notification process to our customers.
The procedure goes under periodic tests to ensure that any gaps are closed and continual improvement is made.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Partners list
 
 
 
 
 
We have partnered with industry leaders to enhance our platform and protect our customers’ data. See complete
 Global Sub-processor List
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Availability and continuity 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Business continuity plan
 
 
 
 
 
Resilience of the platform and availability is a top priority. We acknowledge that disruptions can occur unexpectedly by failures of IT systems or more widespread disasters (e.g. natural disasters, fire, pandemics, terrorism, etc.).
We have established a Business Continuity Management (BCP) Policy & Plan to minimise the impact of disruptions through the development of recovery plans to ensure the timely resumption of essential operations. The BCP plan is tested yearly with our established recovery team to ensure we are prepared in the event we need to action the plan.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Disaster recovery
 
 
 
 
 
We have a Disaster Recovery (DR) Plan for reestablishing the operations of Markeplacer’s platform during an unexpected major event. Our Operations Team can respond to disasters or emergencies and minimise the impact on the platform operations.
The DR plan goes under periodic testing to ensure gaps are addressed promptly and to keep improving. We have DR failover in the same AWS regions if we need to failover to the next closest availability zone, so data stays in Australia, US or EU.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Security in our products
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Endpoint Security 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Our platform has antivirus protection which also provides us with an extensive visibility for endpoint detection and response (EDR) purposes.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Data Encryption 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
To prevent tampering and maintain the confidentiality of data, all data is encrypted using industry-standard cryptographic algorithms and protocols such as AES-256 and TLS 1.2.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 SAML SSO 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Our platform integrates with your SAML SSO provider to unify your team’s authentication and ensure your security monitoring has visibility into when and how your team is accessing the platform.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Customized User Permissions 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customised user access roles and permissions allows you to assign who can access your Marketplacer instance and which of its components.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Report a vulnerability
 
 
 
 
 
We value the security researcher community. Our 
Responsible Disclosure Policy
 provides guidelines on how to report a security vulnerability or bug affecting Marketplacer products and services.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Cybersecurity framework
 
 
 
 
 
We have adopted the NIST Cybersecurity Framework for improving our cybersecurity activities and achieving our cybersecurity objectives.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Security Management Program
 
 
 
 
 
We have developed a Security Management Program based on these recognised industry standards and regulations: ISO 27001, SOC2, PCI-DSS and GDPR. Our security policy and practice go through an extensive review every year. We hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC2 Type I and PCI-DSS certifications.
